nodes.label: Page Envelope (v4.11 Pagination Convention)
nodes.rationale: List endpoints return {items, total, limit, offset} (limit default 20, max 100) — total is required for UI page controls. In-place /api/v1 shape change accepted as a pre-GA exception to the breaking-changes rule; spec bumped v4.10 → v4.11 (§6). Latest-version-only totals and id-desc ordering tiebreaker for stable pages.

nodes.label: Worker Split (God Worker → Two Workers)
nodes.rationale: 1330-line workers/main.py god worker split into embeddings, maintenance, ingestion_pdf, ingestion_html, extraction, llm, common, queues modules. Two processes: default worker (embeddings + review-claim-expiry cron) and ingestion worker on a dedicated 'ingestion' queue. Spec §14 two-worker contract.

nodes.label: Ingestion Queue Routing
nodes.rationale: Queue routing is part of the job contract — ARQ workers fail unregistered jobs, so every ingestion enqueue passes _queue_name via the INGESTION_QUEUE constant (import-light workers/queues.py); enforced by a static call-site scan test.

nodes.label: Worker Startup Recovery Hook
nodes.rationale: Load-bearing per spec §14: resets in-flight chunk statuses (processing → queued, extracting → extraction_queued) when the worker died mid-job, and re-enqueues work. After the worker split it runs on the ingestion worker only. Must never be removed or disabled.

nodes.label: slowapi Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: Blanket 30/min on search and 10/min on ingestion upload covers the main attack surface; LIMITER_STORAGE_URI env var selects the Redis backend in production.

nodes.label: Auth Failure Rate Limiting (Deferred)
nodes.rationale: 5 failures/min per IP deferred — counting only failures requires custom Redis counter middleware, which slowapi does not provide; carried as known-incomplete across sessions.

nodes.label: Shared Lifecycle Actions Service
nodes.rationale: Route dedup via shared service layer (api/services/lifecycle_actions.py) rather than a router factory — keeps route handlers readable and tracebacks clean. assert_can_return and status assertions moved inside; domain/foreign-claim checks stay in route handlers because they need session and entity-specific context.

nodes.label: Audit Log
nodes.rationale: audit_log table, write_audit_event() service and GET /api/v1/audit endpoint added in Sprint 10; event coverage (break_glass_confirm, domain_created, user_domains_updated) wired in Sprint 11 once the confirm-endpoint refactor could thread the session in.

nodes.label: Machine Auth via API Keys
nodes.rationale: Machine/human credential distinction is the 'agent:' role prefix on the same OIDC JWT path — no separate credential type. bp_ API keys use SHA-256 hash lookup; a synthetic User record per key (sub = 'apikey:<id>') lets all existing CurrentUser route dependencies work unchanged. expires_at_days relative expiry chosen as simpler for CLI callers.

nodes.label: Break-Glass Confirm
nodes.rationale: Admins may confirm their own submissions (break-glass for small teams, exemption from self-review prohibition §5.1); requires non-empty justification and always produces a break_glass_confirm audit event.

nodes.label: Fable 5 Review Hardening Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Full platform review documented as memory with a Sprint 11–13 hardening roadmap and sequencing rationale: Sprint 11 audit+rate limits, Sprint 12 pagination+worker split, Sprint 13 deferred product. graphify-out/ committed so remote/expensive model sessions get the graph without regeneration cost.

nodes.label: Weekly Dependency Audit Workflow
nodes.rationale: pip-audit run weekly without --strict — --strict fails on any unauditable package including the local editable install; CVE detection works fine without it. Runs Mondays 09:00 UTC, manually triggerable.

nodes.label: CI Auto-Fix Pipeline
nodes.rationale: claude-code-action is incompatible with non-Anthropic model providers, so a custom script calls synthetic.new with GLM-5.1. Security hardening: write allowlist (api/, tests/, cli/, workers/, pyproject.toml), fork gate on head_repository, checkout of main rather than the failing SHA to prevent pwn-request execution with secrets. Event-driven GitHub Actions chosen over scheduled remote agents due to a 5 runs/day limit on timed automations.

nodes.label: Triage/Extraction Human-Gate Split (§11.5a)
nodes.rationale: Cheap triage estimates candidates and a human corrects before expensive extraction runs — a deliberate architectural decision carried from the MVP (spec v4.6 §11.5a), done as a dedicated sprint rather than winged. _triage_chunk stops at triage_complete and writes estimate rows; extraction is a separate extract_chunk ARQ job triggered by estimate approval; reference_material/skip chunks go straight to done; _extract_from_estimate is idempotent via a chunk_id + record_type guard.

nodes.label: Ingestion Triage Estimates
nodes.rationale: ingestion_triage_estimates table, IngestionTriageEstimate ORM model, and GET/PATCH/merge/approve endpoints supporting the human review gate.

nodes.label: Estimate Review UI
nodes.rationale: Per-chunk review links keep the operator oriented to which section they're reviewing; merge flow uses checkbox-select + merged title input rather than drag-and-drop for consistency and correctness.

nodes.label: LLM JSON Parsing (_parse_llm_json + json_repair)
nodes.rationale: response_format: json_object caused the extraction LLM to invent its own field names; removed entirely in favour of fence stripping plus a json_repair fallback, matching the MVP approach. Prompt parser only captured text up to the next ## heading, silently discarding field definitions — fixed by demoting sections to ###.

nodes.label: Ingestion Pipeline
nodes.rationale: PDF/HTML/JSON source types feeding chunking, triage, extraction, candidate review and commit; produces task and principle candidates only, at draft or submitted status — never confirmed.

nodes.label: HTML Ingestion (Playwright Crawl)
nodes.rationale: crawl_html and render_nav_pages ARQ jobs render with headless Chromium; single and site-nav modes; nav links deduplicated to same origin (conservative cross-origin posture); robots.txt respected by default. Chromium must be installed in the Docker image explicitly because --with-deps fails on python:3.12-slim.

nodes.label: JSON Ingestion
nodes.rationale: JSON payloads bypass chunking and section selection — candidates created synchronously, ingestion immediately ready, no ARQ job. task_order cross-references validated against optional per-item ids (forward references allowed, dangling refs and duplicate ids rejected); import ids are never persisted.

nodes.label: Hybrid Search Service
nodes.rationale: UNION ALL full-text search with optional semantic reranking (60% semantic / 40% FTS); domain filter originally excluded facts and concepts because they have no domain column — they surface implicitly through tasks; stable pagination via ORDER BY fts_score DESC, id.

nodes.label: Embedding Generation Worker
nodes.rationale: generate_embedding enqueued on every confirm transition; calls an OpenAI-compatible embedding API. Latent bug found later: ':embedding::vector' bind-cast syntax is rejected by asyncpg — fixed with CAST(:embedding AS vector); embeddings had been silently broken until tests exposed it. Embedding dimension is fixed — changing the model requires a breaking re-embed migration.

nodes.label: Notifications System
nodes.rationale: record_submitted and claim_made notify all domain users; record_confirmed/record_returned notify only the author; claim_expired notifies only the former claimer. expire_review_claims converted from raw SQL to ORM so claimer IDs are accessible for notifications. SMTP delivery deferred as spec-optional.

nodes.label: System Settings Store
nodes.rationale: DB-backed key/value store; DB values override env vars via a per-job resolver in the worker (not a startup overlay) so LLM config changes take effect on the next job without a worker restart. LLM API keys encrypted with Fernet keyed from app_secret_key; encrypted values are write-only, never returned via GET.

nodes.label: Review Claims and Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Claims started advisory (48h default expiry, expire_review_claims cron) and were later made enforced — only the claim holder may confirm or return; the timeout handles abandoned claims. Confirm removed from the queue row so reviewers must open the record, preventing rubber-stamp approvals. Facts and concepts were never claimable.

nodes.label: Revise Flow
nodes.rationale: Revise is allowed from any status, not just returned — the governance cycle handles it regardless of starting state. Returned records inherit the return note as the revision note; all other statuses require an explicit note. Duplicate-draft prevention via 409 when record_id/version+1 exists. List endpoints dedup to latest version per record_id.

nodes.label: Governance Lifecycle State Machine
nodes.rationale: draft → submitted → confirmed (plus return, deprecate, retire) enforced in api/services/lifecycle.py via assert_can_edit/submit/confirm/return/deprecate/retire; immutability applies only after submit; records are versioned with a stable record_id and per-version UUID.

nodes.label: Self-Review Prohibition
nodes.rationale: No contributor may confirm their own submission (§5.1); admins are exempt as a break-glass for small teams. The companion no-machine-can-confirm rule was enforced in phases: Sprints 4–9 by requiring a human OIDC JWT (sufficient since machine credentials didn't exist), Sprint 10 by explicit rejection of agent: credentials.

nodes.label: Domain Enforcement (§7.3)
nodes.rationale: Contributors may only create/submit/confirm domain-scoped records (tasks, workflows, principles) within assigned domains; domains and user_domains tables; assert_domain_active and assert_domain_access in the lifecycle service; admins implicitly own all domains.

nodes.label: Facts/Concepts Dissolution (v4.4)
nodes.rationale: Facts and Concepts dissolved as independently governed records into TEXT[] arrays on tasks — extraction produces string arrays incompatible with confirmed-record refs at commit time, and dev-only data allowed a clean drop with no migration path. procedure_name dropped as duplicating the task title (v4.5).

nodes.label: bp Design System
nodes.rationale: --bp-* CSS custom properties coexist with shadcn vars to avoid breaking existing components; Inter typeface; dark sidebar rail shell; all app pages migrated to bp-page/bp-card/bp-btn classes across two sessions.

nodes.label: StatusBadge Component
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for all status rendering; lifecycle and ingestion statuses mapped to the nearest lifecycle palette class; extended later for triage_complete/extraction statuses.

nodes.label: OIDC PKCE Auth Flow
nodes.rationale: Browser SPA uses oidc-client-ts with PKCE and a Public (not Confidential) Authentik client — a SPA must not hold a client secret. sessionStorage chosen for tokens as the conservative XSS posture. Roles claim key is 'groups', not 'blueprinted_roles' — Authentik's scope name and claim name are independent. Vite dev proxy used instead of backend CORS.

nodes.label: Authentik Identity Provider
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted OIDC provider with groups matching the five Blueprinted roles (admin, contributor, content_publisher, viewer, audit); RS256 JWKS validated by the FastAPI backend.
